experiment_data.hypothesis: Ablation: perdof CRM v3-norm with DEFAULT max_correction_norm (~1.42, no magnitude control) on LIBERO object benchmark. Tests whether magnitude control is essential on object domain too. If v4-default << v4-perdof (norm=0.1) → magnitude control is universally needed. If v4-default ≈ v4-perdof → spatial failure was anomalous.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement && HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 MUJOCO_GL=egl python -u src/evaluate.py --mode acr_vla --benchmark object --n_rollouts 10 --seed 42 --K 10 --crm_checkpoint /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/crm_v3_norm/perdof/crm_best.pt --output_file logs/eval_object_v4_default.json"
